apiKeys.title: API Key Management
apiKeys.noQuotaAlerts: No quota alerts at the moment

quotaAlertsActions.resetConfirm: Reset today's usage for this key? The alert will clear; the limits themselves stay unchanged.
quotaAlertsActions.keyNotFound: This key was not found in the list - it may have been deleted

form.descriptionRequired: Please enter a description for this key
form.expiresAtHint: Defaults to 90 days; clear for never expires
form.permissionsHint: Defines which API categories this key may call (e.g. /v1/chat/completions is chat). Must match the category of the model groups it accesses, otherwise the call is rejected. Chat is checked by default
form.quotaPresetHint: Pick a preset to fill the limits below (0 = unlimited), still adjustable
form.ipWhitelistPlaceholder: Leave empty to allow all IPs
form.ipWhitelistHint: IP addresses allowed to use this key; empty means no restriction
form.allowedModelsPlaceholder: Leave empty to allow all models
form.allowedModelsHint: Restrict this key to the selected models/instances (matched by the model parameter). Empty means all models under the granted permission.
form.allowedGroupsPlaceholder: Leave empty to allow all groups
form.allowedGroupsHint: Restrict this key to the selected model groups (pools). Empty means no extra group restriction.
form.permissionsMismatch: The selected model group belongs to the "{categories}" category, which is not checked under "Callable model categories". Calls will be rejected with 403. Please check the matching category.
form.tokenLimitHint: Daily token usage cap; 0 means no limit
form.rateLimitHint: Per-minute request rate cap; 0 means no limit
form.thresholdHint: Trigger an alert when quota usage reaches this ratio
form.rotationPeriodHint: Auto-rotation period for the key (in days); 0 means no auto-rotation
form.allowedModelsScopeHint: Only models whose categories match the checked permissions are listed; selected items will be flagged as mismatched after their category is unchecked
form.allowedGroupsScopeHint: Only model groups whose categories match the checked permissions are listed
form.whitelistDisabledHint: Check at least one callable category first: with empty permissions this key cannot call any API and the whitelist has no effect
form.permissionsMismatchScope: The selected models/groups belong to '{categories}', but the corresponding categories are not checked in 'Callable model categories' above; calls will be rejected with 403. Check those categories or remove them from the whitelist.
form.gatesAlertTitle: API calls pass through three gates
form.gate1Desc: Gate 1 — Model categories (required): the key can only call APIs of the checked categories; none checked = cannot call anything
form.gate2Desc: Gate 2 — Model whitelist (optional): restrict which models/groups inside those categories; leave empty = all models in the checked categories are allowed
form.gate3Desc: Gate 3 — Safety rails (optional): expiry time, IP whitelist and quotas as a backstop
form.advancedHint: Description + categories are enough for normal use; whitelist, expiry, IP / quota limits live in advanced mode

keyValueDialog.tip: Please save the key value below. It is shown only once:
keyValueDialog.warning: The key value is shown only once and cannot be retrieved again after closing this dialog! If you lose it, use the reset function to generate a new key.

import.note1: A new key value will be generated for each key on import; key values from the original config are not imported.
import.mergeNote: MERGE mode: keeps existing keys and only adds new ones.
import.replaceNote: REPLACE mode: deletes all existing keys before importing new ones.
import.uploadText: Drag a JSON file here, or
import.newKeysTitle: New key values (shown only once — please save them)

confirmations.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete API key {keyId}? This action cannot be undone.
confirmations.deleteImpact: If applications are still calling this key, they will immediately start receiving 401 authentication failures.
confirmations.deleteRemedy: You can create a new key if this was a mistake; the old key value cannot be recovered and every consumer must be updated.
confirmations.resetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset API key {keyId}? The old key value will be invalidated immediately, and the new one is shown only once.
confirmations.rotateMessage: Are you sure you want to rotate API key {keyId}? The old key value will be invalidated immediately, and the new one is shown only once. The lastRotatedAt timestamp will be updated.
confirmations.quotaResetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset the daily quota counter of API key {keyId}? This clears today's request and token usage.

messages.fetchListFailed: Failed to fetch the API key list
messages.keyIdTooLong: Key ID must not exceed 64 characters
messages.resetSuccess: Key reset successfully. Please save the new key value!
messages.rotateSuccess: Key rotated successfully. Please save the new key value!
messages.createSuccess: Created successfully. Please keep the key value safe!
messages.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please copy it manually
messages.importParseFailed: Failed to parse the JSON file
messages.importSelectFile: Please select a config file to import first
messages.whitelistMismatchBlocked: Save failed: the categories of these models/groups are not covered by the key permissions — {detail}. Grant those categories or remove them from the whitelist.

batch.deleteImpact: Impact: {count} key(s) will be invalidated immediately; calls using them will return 401
batch.deleteRemedy: Remedy: deleted keys cannot be restored; you must issue new keys and update your clients
